segments.name: Oral, Personal and Home Care
segments.description: Manufactures and markets oral care, personal care and home care products sold to retailers, wholesalers and distributors worldwide.
segments.evidence: We operate in two product segments: Oral, Personal and Home Care; and Pet Nutrition.

segments.name: Pet Nutrition
segments.description: Produces specialty pet nutrition products for dogs and cats sold through pet retailers, veterinarians and eCommerce.
segments.evidence: Through our Hill's Pet Nutrition segment ("Hill's" or "Pet Nutrition"), we are a leader in specialty pet nutrition products for dogs and cats with products marketed in over 80 countries and territories worldwide.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and pet owners pay for consumer packaged goods sold through retailers, wholesalers, distributors, veterinarians and direct-to-consumer channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Oral, Personal and Home Care products are sold to a variety of retailers, wholesalers and distributors worldwide. Pet Nutrition products are sold by authorized pet supply retailers, veterinarians and eCommerce retailers. Certain of our products are also sold direct-to-consumer.
